items.exampleEn: My dad drinks cola every day.
There are many fast food restaurants near the station.
items.exampleZh: 車站附近有很多速食店。

items.exampleEn: The main course will be ready in ten minutes.
I always carry mineral water in my bag.
items.exampleZh: 我包包裡總是帶著礦泉水。

items.exampleEn: I like bread with olive oil.
This shop sells soft drinks and ice cream.
items.exampleZh: 這家店賣汽水和冰淇淋。

items.sentenceEn: I don't eat fast food very often.

items.audioEn: For the main course, you can choose chicken or fish.
items.audioZh: 主菜你可以選雞肉或魚。

items.sentenceEn: This salad has olive oil and lemon on it.
items.sentenceZh: 這份沙拉淋了橄欖油和檸檬汁。

items.sentenceEn: Soft drinks have a lot of sugar.

items.stemEn: I'm thirsty. Can I have a bottle of ____?
items.stemZh: 我好渴，可以給我一瓶礦泉水嗎？

items.stemEn: Would you like a ____ with your burger?
items.stemZh: 你的漢堡要不要配一杯可樂？

items.passageEn: Last night, Nina and her friends went to a nice restaurant. They usually eat fast food, but it was Nina's birthday. For the main course, Nina had fish cooked in olive oil, and her friends had steak. Her friends drank cola, but Nina only wanted mineral water. The next morning, she made a big omelet at home.
items.passageZh: 昨晚，Nina 和朋友們去了一家不錯的餐廳。他們平常都吃速食，但那天是 Nina 的生日。主菜 Nina 點了用橄欖油煮的魚，朋友們點了牛排。朋友們喝可樂，Nina 只想喝礦泉水。隔天早上，她在家做了一個大大的歐姆蛋。

questions.questionZh: 他們那天為什麼去一家不錯的餐廳？
options: 那天是 Nina 的生日
那家餐廳那天剛好在打八折

items.promptZh: 孩子們只能喝不含酒精的飲料。
referenceEn: The children can only have soft drinks.
The kids can only drink soft drinks.
rubricZh: 「不含酒精的飲料」可寫 soft drinks

items.promptZh: 我爸爸每個星期天早上做歐姆蛋給我們吃。
referenceEn: My father makes omelets for us every Sunday morning.
Every Sunday morning, my dad makes us omelets.
rubricZh: 用 omelet 表示「歐姆蛋」，單數、複數都可以（例如 omelets、an omelet 等）
習慣用現在簡單式，主詞是單數，動詞加 s（例如 makes、cooks 等）
「做…給我們吃」可寫，例如 makes omelets for us、makes us omelets 等
